⌊ DRAFT g The Cross Cluster Communication on the server side of the Software Cluster Connection shall handle the requests in a first-in-first-out queue.

⌊ DRAFT g The Cross Cluster Communication of the Software Cluster Connection shall make the request queue instance created according to [SWS_SwCluC_03150] accessible for the Software Cluster implementing the server, via a Resource Entry in the Binary Manifest .

⌊ DRAFT g The Cross Cluster Communication of the Software Cluster Connection shall make the response queue instance created according to [SWS_SwCluC_03151] accessible to the Software Cluster , via a Resource Entry in the Binary Manifest .

⌊ DRAFT g The Cross Cluster Communication of the Software Cluster Connection shall use the transaction handle for the identification of client server transactions, communicated between the clusters.
⌊ DRAFT g The Cross Cluster Communication on the server side of the Software Cluster Connection shall return the transaction handle of the request, without modification, together with the response.
⌊ DRAFT g The Cross Cluster Communication of the Software Cluster Connection shall allow only one request per client and server operation at any time.

⌊ DRAFT g If the corresponding resource in the Binary Manifest representing the response queue (See [SWS_SwCluC_03157]) is connected, the Rte_Rips_Invoke shall copy the IN and IN/OUT parameters, inform the server via a status flag, and return RTE_E_OK.

⌊ DRAFT g If the corresponding resource in the Binary Manifest representing the response queue (See [SWS_SwCluC_03157]) is connected, the Rte_Rips_Invoke shall return RTE_E_LIMIT, until the server's result has been successfully passed to the client, and no timeout occurred. ⌊ DRAFT g If the corresponding resource in the Binary Manifest representing the response queue (See [SWS_SwCluC_03157]) is connected, the Rte_Rips_ReturnResult shall return RTE_E_NO_DATA, until the server's result has been successfully passed to the client and no timeout occurred.

⌊ DRAFT g If the corresponding resource in the Binary Manifest representing the response queue (See [SWS_SwCluC_03157]) is connected, and the server's result was not available within the specified timeout, the Rte_Rips_ReturnResult shall return RTE_E_TIMEOUT.
